title: k11 Playwright QA MCP Server
description:
MCP server and Claude Code plugin for Playwright: turns user stories into tests with locators verified on the live page, runs them with structured results, and heals broken locators with a confidence score, reasons and the runner-up. heal-ci applies safe fixes in CI and opens a pull request with an audit report.

Source code: https://github.com/K11-Software-Solutions/k11techlab-playwright-qa-mcp
